ai_content.description:
Rifle Guru is your trusted destination for all things firearms and outdoor sports in Idaho's Treasure Valley. Conveniently located just 10 minutes north of Eagle, on Hwy 55, we specialize in personalized customer service that sets us apart from big-box stores. Our owner, a native Idahoan and former Army veteran turned police officer, brings a unique blend of expertise to our gunsmithing services and hunting advice.

At Rifle Guru Long Range Shooting, you'll find a wide selection of custom rifles, scopes, ammunition, and accessories tailored to meet your specific needs. Whether you're a seasoned hunter or an avid shooter looking to improve your skills, our staff will work closely with you to ensure the right fit for your next adventure. We pride ourselves on being a locally-owned business deeply rooted in the Idaho community, committed to upholding 2A values and promoting responsible firearms ownership.

With hours by appointment Monday through Saturday from 10 AM to 6 PM (or visit our online store 24/7), we make it easy to explore our inventory and receive expert advice on everything from hunting season prep to long-range shooting techniques. Trust Rifle Guru for exceptional service, knowledge, and products that embody the authentic spirit of Idaho's outdoor enthusiasts.

In the heart of Meridian, Idaho, Independence Indoor Shooting offers an unparalleled experience for firearms enthusiasts and families alike. As you step into our state-of-the-art facility, you'll discover three indoor ranges catering to various needs, including one impressive 100-yard range that's sure to test your skills. Our pro shop boasts an extensive selection of ammunition, optics, and accessories from top brands.

Beyond just shooting facilities, Independence is also home to a renowned academy where experienced professionals guide newcomers through gun safety and handling courses. For those seeking custom work, our skilled gunsmiths are equipped with cutting-edge tools to precision-craft or modify your firearm to meet your specific requirements. Whether you're a seasoned hunter or a newcomer to the world of firearms, we're committed to providing expert advice in a welcoming environment.

Located on East Gala Court in Meridian, Idaho, Independence Indoor Shooting embodies the spirit of community involvement and responsible firearms ownership. By focusing on exceptional service, industry knowledge, and accessibility, we strive to make every visit an enjoyable experience for both new and returning customers. As you explore our website and facilities, discover why Independence is the go-to destination for shooting enthusiasts across the Treasure Valley region.

scraped_content.main_text: Black's Creek Public Shooting Range | Idaho Fish and Game Skip to main content Search Idaho Fish and Game Black's Creek Public Shooting Range Black's Creek Public Shooting Range (BCR), located just southeast of Boise, is the largest and most visited shooting range in Idaho, providing a safe place to shoot for more than 14,000 hunters and sport shooters each year. BCR is one of four Idaho shooting ranges owned by the Idaho Department of Fish and Game. The non-profit shooting club, the EE-DA-HOW Long Rifle & Pistol Club is responsible for day to day operation of BCR. HoursBCR may close due to inclement weather and road conditions. Check the Facebook page @Black's Creek Public Shooting Range for up to date range information.PLEASE NOTE:Black's Creek Upcoming Range Closures (Summer 2025)Friday, June 13 and Sunday, June 15, 2025: 500M range closed for Idaho State BPCR Silhouette ChampionshipsAside from the above closure dates, the 500M range is open Fridays and Sundays, and the main range is open for summer hours June 1 - Oct 31 Thursday through Sunday from 8am - 6pm. November 1 - May 31Main Range: 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., Friday through Sunday500M Range: 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Fridays and SundaysLast admission time is one hour prior to scheduled closing.June 1 - October 31Main Range: 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., Thursday through Sunday500M Range: 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Fridays and SundaysLast admission time is one hour prior to scheduled closing.*Note: Black’s Creek will be closed to the public on Easter Sunday, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Years Eve, and New Years Day.Our Monthly Calendar is up to date on our Facebook page:Follow us on Facebook - @BlacksCreekRangeFEE SCHEDULE Things to know:With 36 shooting benches, the main range accommodates shooting distances from 5 to 200 yards.There are no restrictions on the number of firearms a person may use on the range during a shooting session; however, only one firearm is permitted at the shooting bench at a time.Approved firearms include air rifle, centerfire, rimfire and black powder rifles and pistols.Ammunition restrictions: Armor piercing, incendiary, tracer, steel core and steel/bi-metal jacket ammunition are prohibited.Exploding targets not permitted.BCR does not provide gun rentals.Both the range and the on-site restrooms are accessible to physically-challenged shooters.See a map of the 500m Range Distances and Targets Events and AlertsSee the events list for specialized shooting opportunities.Please contact the range for any unlisted range closures. ai_content.description:
In the heart of Kuna, just off Highway 69, lies Black's Creek Public Shooting Range - one of four esteemed ranges owned by the Idaho Department of Fish and Game. This non-profit gem is operated in partnership with the EE-DA-HOW Long Rifle & Pistol Club, ensuring top-notch facilities for firearms enthusiasts.

BCR offers an expansive outdoor shooting complex where folks can hone their marksmanship skills, regardless of experience level. With a focus on safety and accessibility, this range caters to hunting aficionados and recreational shooters alike, providing ample opportunities for practice and training. From gun storage services to ammunition sales, BCR has got you covered - making it your go-to destination for all things firearms and hunting in Idaho's Treasure Valley region.

Whether you're preparing for deer season or simply looking to improve your aim, Black's Creek Public Shooting Range is the perfect spot to "draw tags" with confidence. As one of the most trusted public ranges in the Gem State, BCR prides itself on its commitment to community engagement and outdoor education, ensuring that each visit is both enjoyable and informative.
